name: print-social-blue-tinted-concert-photo-closing-slide-with-website-headline
title: Blue-Tinted Concert Photo Closing Slide
whatItIs: A closing slide over a blue-tinted photograph of a concert crowd with stage lights, a ticket logo at the top, a large white 'TIXPOOL.COM' headline, a short rule and three lines: a bold offer 'List your ticket. Get your money.', an italic aside and a smaller quiet line.
whatItMeans: Tinting the crowd photo in the brand blue makes the closing feel atmospheric while keeping the site name front and centre.
techniques: Blue tint over a concert photograph
Three text tiers under a short rule

vocabulary.definition: A translucent colour laid over a photo.
A website address used as the main call to action.
The last slide of a carousel with the final ask.
